# American Osteopathic Association

> The American Osteopathic Association represents 207,000+ Doctors of Osteopathic Medicine (DOs) and provides board certification, physician directories, and resources for osteopathic medicine.

The AOA is the professional organization for osteopathic physicians in the United States, offering board certification across 27 specialties, a directory to find DOs in your community, and educational resources. Osteopathic medicine emphasizes whole-person, patient-centered care with specialized training in Osteopathic Manipulative Treatment (OMT).

## Key Topics

- Doctors of Osteopathic Medicine (DOs)
- American Osteopathic Association (AOA)

## Core Resources

- [American Osteopathic Association | AOA](https://osteopathic.org): AOA homepage representing 207,000+ osteopathic physicians
- [Find a DO | Doctors of Osteopathic Medicine](https://findado.osteopathic.org): Directory to find Doctors of Osteopathic Medicine in your community
- [Board Certification | American Osteopathic Association](https://certification.osteopathic.org): AOA board certification in 27 specialties and 49 subspecialties
